name: Condemn Soul

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
With a quick flourish, you draw together runes and legal bindings to condemn a creature's soul and bring it to justice. Select a creature within 30 feet of you; that creature must attempt a Will save save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. Regardless of the result, the target is then temporarily immune to your Condemn Soul for 1 day.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure Your condemnation frays the fabric of the target's soul. The target gains weakness to fire and spirit damage equal to half your level for 1 minute. Only you can trigger this weakness.

Critical Failure As failure, but any creature can trigger the creature's weakness.

Effect: Condemn Soul
